TAL_TRAP_TRAP_LAUNCHER.name: Trap Launcher

activation.trigger: When you expend Martial Focus to set a trap as an Action

riders: Prerequisite: CL 5+
description: The projectile must have a legal route.
Trap Launcher does not allow a trap to pass through Total Cover or attach to an unsupported space.

TAL_TRAP_STOP_DROP_AND_CONTROL.name: Stop, Drop, and Control

activation.trigger: When you take the Disengage Action

riders: Setting traps along movement above ground still needs manual tracking of the exact physical spaces traversed.

TAL_TRAP_PURSUIT_LATTICE.name: Pursuit Lattice

activation.trigger: When you use Stop, Drop, and Control

riders: Both traps must use different actual spaces traversed; movement above ground still needs manual tracking.
description: Both traps count against your active trap limit.
